purpose: Document local state land registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry-route review.
assessment: ENGIS is the Enugu State land-administration platform and describes property/parcel mapping from official survey records. Its visible map viewer path redirected to account login, and historical survey lookup is explicitly priced. No credentials, payment, property search or owner/address data were used; no anonymous feature payload/schema was verified.
registryAssessment: State registry and survey services exist. The state-wide platform description does not establish LGA digitization completeness or an anonymous public feature service at the WUP locator.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Enugu State Government states the ENGIS law provides legal backing for digital land administration and reports launch of digital land transactions.
State platform describes ENGIS as land administration with parcel mapping, verification, records, survey services and LGA digitization updates; services require a registered account.

Office of the Surveyor General page describes property mapping and boundaries from registered survey plans; visible Launch Map Viewer navigation redirects to a login page. It says prior survey lookup requires a ₦10,000 payment.
Official Office of the Surveyor General portal describes the new digital survey management system.
